provenance: Enumerated by reading the contract end to end (v1, 68), then extended (v2, +17) by reviewing every grounded record from two different models that v1 did not cover and verifying each against the contract text. NOT independently reviewed by a second labeller. Known bias: the v2 additions were surfaced by model output, so an obligation that BOTH models and the original reading missed is still invisible here. Pure definitions and scope prose were deliberately excluded.
